pc_inositol.name: Myo-Inositol Complex
pc_inositol.key: 6 capsules: 3,902 mg myo‑inositol + 97 mg D‑chiro‑inositol (40:1), 200 mcg chromium, 500 mg fenugreek seed extract, 300 mg Ceylon cinnamon
pc_inositol.src: Label: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Myo-Inositol Complex SS ND680' Rev. 2/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Myo-Inositol Complex SS ND680.pdf, opened with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-03; the same panel is in scratchpad labels/labels.json R279. Supplement Facts, serving 6 capsules, 30 servings: chromium (as chromium picolinate) 200 mcg (571% DV), myo-inositol 3,902 mg, fenugreek extract (seed; Trigonella foenum-graecum) 500 mg, Ceylon cinnamon powder (bark) 300 mg, D-chiro-inositol 97 mg (3,902:97 = 40:1). The serving line says 'fenugreek seed extract' because the 500 mg is an extract, not whole seed. Directions: 'Take six capsules daily in two divided doses'. Caution: 'If pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' The fenugreek is why the check panel's pregnancy note names this product: fenugreek 'is not recommended for use during pregnancy' (Ouzir M et al., Food Chem Toxicol 2016;96:145-54, PMID 27498339, doi:10.1016/j.fct.2016.08.003: teratogenic, anti-implantation and abortifacient findings) and fenugreek seed extract was toxic to development in pregnant mice (Khalki L et al., J Ethnopharmacol 2010;131:321-5, PMID 20600755, doi:10.1016/j.jep.2010.06.033), both read on PubMed 2026-11-03. Its chromium, fenugreek and cinnamon also bear on blood sugar, so the practitioner edition's medicine note names it next to Berberine Pro. Card claims, from the same sheet: 'Support healthy ovarian function', 'Support healthy menstrual cycles', 'Support optimal blood glucose balance'. Size 180C: ND144 price list Rev. 10.1.26. Dose bar: 3 capsules twice daily is the label's six a day in two doses and the NutriDyn GLC 2023 PCOS protocol's 'Myo-Inositol Complex: 3 BID', re-opened 2026-11-03). The NutriDyn GLC 2026 PMOS protocol, re-opened 2026-11-03) calls it 'the best-supported supplement here'. Asher offers it by name for PCOS patients (Asher's Myo-Inositol Complex email to a practitioner, 2026-09-25). No verified product-page slug, so the link falls back to the nutridyn.com catalog search. PHOTO, PRINT HOLD: the only staged photo is a soft stopgap, 344x640 enlarged from an 86x160 chart thumbnail (img-src/inositol.png and img-src/R279.png, both listed in img-src/soft.json; the build prints SOFT PRODUCT PHOTOS), so this sheet is web-only until the real bottle is staged. Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/R279_Web, the byte range of that folder's 420 px renders) is the real NutriDyn bottle; its download host (dl.dropboxusercontent.com) and nutridyn.com answer 403 from this session's proxy, so it was not fetched. When it is staged, save it as img-src/pc_inositol.png or take R279 and inositol out of soft.json: the build counts a soft-listed file at a quarter of its height, so a crisp 420 px file saved over R279.png would still lose to the 640 px enlargement. Sheet-local key: replaces the old 'inositol' override, which no other sheet used.

pc_berberine.name: Berberine Pro
pc_berberine.key: Per capsule: 100 mg dihydroberberine + 84 mg organic Ceylon cinnamon extract
pc_berberine.src: Label: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Berberine Pro SS ND1130' Rev. 11/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Berberine Pro SS ND1130.pdf, opened with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-03. Supplement Facts, serving 1 capsule, 90 servings: dihydroberberine (GlucoVantage) 100 mg; organic cinnamon extract (bark; Cinnamomum ceylon) 84 mg. Directions: 'Take one capsule three times daily before meals'. Caution: 'If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' Card claims, from the same sheet: 'Promotes healthy glucose metabolism', 'Supports heart health & optimal lipid balance'. Same facts in the products DB (R2125, DFH/Ortho/Thorne chart label reads of catalog ND143 10/1/26); size R2125 90C. Trade name: the serving line prints 'dihydroberberine' without 'GlucoVantage', a registered trademark of NNB Nutrition (ND1130's attribution line), as the insulin-resistance sheet does for the same bottle, so it needs neither the mark nor the attribution; the no-break space keeps 'cinnamon extract' together. Protocols: NutriDyn GLC 2023 PCOS protocol 'Berberine Pro: TID (depending on labs)' and NutriDyn GLC 2026 PMOS protocol 'Berberine Pro: 1 cap TID wf', both re-opened 2026-11-03; the sheet prints the label timing. Daily rhythm: three doses, each before a meal (the dose bar says 'before meals'); the shared rhythm has no midday slot, so the breakfast and lunch doses share the Morning box and only the dinner dose sits under Evening meal, as on the insulin-resistance and fatty-liver sheets. URL: Asher's Own Every Protocol page (HbA1c path) links https://nutridyn.com/berberine-pro. Photo: the 258x420 NutriDyn web render (blasts/assets/berberine-pro.png, pooled with img-src/R2125.png), about 430 ppi at the 0.98 in print height.

pc_d3_5000_k2.name: D3 5000 with K2
pc_d3_5000_k2.key: 5,000 IU (125 mcg) vitamin D3, 60 mcg vitamin K2 (MK‑7), 15 mcg vitamin K1
pc_d3_5000_k2.src: Label: NutriDyn sell sheet 'D3 5000 with K2 SS ND382' Rev. 6/24 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/D3 5000 with K2 SS ND382.pdf, opened with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-03 and re-opened the same day for the review. Supplement Facts, serving 1 softgel, 60 servings: vitamin D3 (as cholecalciferol) 125 mcg (5,000 IU), vitamin K1 (as phytonadione) 15 mcg, vitamin K2 as MK-7 (MenaQ7) 60 mcg. Directions, as printed on ND382: 'Take one softgel daily with food or as directed by your healthcare practitioner'; the products DB's 'daily as a dietary supplement' is a competitor chart's read of the label, and the sell sheet is the source, so 'with dinner' is the label's 'with food'. Warnings printed on the label: 'Use should be short-term and include regular monitoring of 25-(OH)- and 1,25-(OH)2-vitamin D levels. This product contains vitamin D at a level that exceeds the adult tolerable upper intake level.' (hence the dose bar's 'short-term; check your level' and the labs note's 'above the 4,000 IU upper limit, so use it short-term and recheck'; 4,000 IU is the adult upper level, NIH Office of Dietary Supplements) and 'Vitamin K2 may counteract the effects of anticoagulation therapy and is not recommended for patients on blood-thinning medications.' The softgel also has 15 mcg K1, so both editions say 'the vitamin K (K1 and K2)' and send anyone on a blood thinner to ask first. Card claims from the same sheet: 'Supports healthy mood and stress levels', 'Supports bone and skin tissues', 'Supports immune function'; 'Supports healthy vitamin D levels' paraphrases its 'help ensure users obtain adequate amounts'. Same amounts in the products DB R197 (catalog ND143 10/1/26), size 60S. Protocol: NutriDyn GLC 2023 PCOS protocol 'Vit D3 5000 IU'. URL slug from products.py SLUGS, also linked on Asher's Own Every Protocol page. Photo: the 270x420 NutriDyn web render (blasts/assets/d3-5000-with-k2.png, pooled with img-src/R197.png), about 430 ppi at the 0.98 in print height.

pc_omega.name: Omega Pure EPA‑DHA 1000
pc_omega.src: Label: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000 SS ND416' Rev. 4/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000 SS ND416.pdf, opened with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-03 and re-opened the same day for the review. Supplement Facts, serving 1 softgel, 120 servings: total omega-3 fatty acids 1.1 g, EPA 730 mg, DHA 270 mg, additional omega-3 100 mg; contains fish (anchovy, sardine, mackerel). Directions: 'Take one softgel 1-3 times daily with food'. Claims printed on ND416: 'Healthy cardiovascular function', 'Healthy immune function', 'Musculoskeletal support', 'Skin vitality', 'Cognitive support'; the card's bullets are the first, and the second with the fourth ('Supports healthy immune function and skin'). ND416 makes no triglyceride claim, so the card makes none, and the need reads 'Essential omega-3 fats' (ND416: omega-3s are 'essential' because the body does not make them) instead of the old 'Healthy blood fats', which implied that claim; the insulin-resistance sheet made the same change for this bottle. Same amounts in the products DB R243. Protocols: NutriDyn GLC 2026 PMOS protocol 'Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000: 2 softgels BID wf for the triglycerides' and NutriDyn GLC 2023 PCOS protocol 'Fish oils: 2 BID', both re-opened 2026-11-03 (4 a day, above the label's 3); the sheet prints 2 a day with food, inside the label. URL slug from products.py SLUGS, also linked on Asher's Own Every Protocol page. No-break hyphen and space so the name breaks only as 'Omega Pure / EPA-DHA 1000' (kit.print_safe prints a plain hyphen); the no-break space keeps '270 mg DHA)' together. Photo: the 244x420 NutriDyn web render (blasts/assets/omega-pure-epa-dha-1000.png, pooled with img-src/R243.png), about 430 ppi at the 0.98 in print height.

pc_ultrabiotic.name: UltraBiotic Daily Multi‑Strain
pc_ultrabiotic.key: 30 billion CFU, 7 strains: 4 Lactobacillus, B. lactis, Bacillus coagulans, S. boulardii
pc_ultrabiotic.src: Label: NutriDyn sell sheet 'UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain SS ND460' Rev. 7/24 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain SS ND460.pdf, opened with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-03. Supplement Facts, serving 1 capsule, 30/60 servings, CFU at time of manufacture: Saccharomyces boulardii (Lynside) 5 billion, Lactobacillus reuteri (LRC) 5 billion, Bifidobacterium lactis UABla-12, Lactobacillus plantarum UALp-05, L. acidophilus UALa-01, L. gasseri UALg-05 and Bacillus coagulans UABc-20 at 4.167 billion each = 30 billion. Directions: 'Take one capsule daily'. Card claims from the same sheet: 'Support a healthy gut microbiome' and, in its text, 'promote healthy hormone functions'. Sizes: products DB R829 30C and R829L 60C (ND144 10/1/26). Dose and timing: Asher's PCOS patient handout (repo handouts/pcos-probiotic-patient-handout.pdf): 'Daily Dose: 1 capsule', 'Best Time: With a meal, same time each day', 'Give it 12 weeks before you judge it'. URL: Asher's PCOS blast (repo blasts/pcos-probiotic.html) and products.py SLUGS. The serving line groups the strains: L. reuteri, L. plantarum, L. acidophilus and L. gasseri are the 4 Lactobacillus; B. lactis is Bifidobacterium, and Bacillus coagulans is spelled out so the two B. genera cannot be confused. Taken with breakfast (Morning box), per the handout's 'with a meal'. No-break hyphen keeps 'Multi-Strain' whole. Photo: img-src/R829.png, the 420x420 NutriDyn render, about 430 ppi at the 0.98 in print height.
